title: A Phase 1/2a, First-in-human, Study of BMS-986517 in Participants with Advanced Solid Tumors
official: A Phase 1/2a, First-in-human, Open label Study of BMS-986517 as Monotherapy or Combination Therapy in Adult Participants with Advanced Solid Tumors
summary: Main objective: To find out what doses of BMS-986517, given alone or combined with an investigational medicine, are safe in order to choose the best dose(s) for future use (Part 1) and check if giving BMS-986517, alone or combined with an investigational drug, at the chosen dose(s) continues to be safe for people with specific cancers (Part 2).
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants must be at least 18 years old at the time of signing the ICF.
2. They must have at least one measurable tumor and should be in good overall health, able to carry out most regular daily tasks.
3. Participants must have advanced cancer that cannot be removed by surgery or has spread to other parts of the body. The types of cancer include lung, head and neck, and breast cancer.
4. Participants must have already received treatment for their advanced cancer.
5. Participants may need to agree to have two tumor biopsies (one before and one during treatment) in one of the sub-parts of the study.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Untreated CNS metastases will be excluded. Participants are eligible if CNS metastases have been treated and do not require immediate treatment or have been treated and have neurologically returned to baseline (except for residual signs or symptoms related to the CNS treatment).
2. Concurrent malignancy (present during Screening) requiring treatment or history of prior  malignancy active within 2 years prior to treatment assignment will be excluded.
3. Participants with history of serious recurrent infections will be excluded.
4. Participants with impaired cardiac function or history of severe heart disease.
